facts.business: S & T Corporation Limited is engaged in real estate development, trading in yarn and other textile products, and leasing of properties.

segments.name: Trading in Yarn and Other Textile Products

key_risks: Increasing prices of key construction materials such as steel, cement, and energy
Regulatory and compliance requirements including environmental clearances and land-related approvals
Delays in obtaining approvals or changes in regulatory policies
Macroeconomic uncertainties, geopolitical developments, and volatility in commodity prices
Increasing focus on sustainability and green building standards
Fluctuations in raw material prices for textile trading
Changes in global demand for textiles
facts.related_party_note: According to the information and explanations given by the management, transactions with the related parties are in compliance with section 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statement, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
